dialogs-input-*: Dialogs unified on .ko-dialog (UI.dialog): buttons are .ko-btn (16px side padding, primary = semibold), the check row is .ko-check-row (14px tick), the field help line is .kb-field-help.
dialogs-about-*: About: .ko-kv list (8px rows, --text-2 keys, medium values) and .ko-meter storage bar replace the About-only copies; .ko-btn buttons.
dialogs-wi-fi-networks-*: Wi-Fi: Disconnect/Details/Forget are .ko-btn--sm (same 40px); header from UI.sheetHead.
dialogs-confirm-*: Confirm dialogs: .ko-btn buttons (16px padding), danger/primary semibold.
library-extras-tools-progress-sync-newer: Dialog buttons are .ko-btn (16px padding) instead of the dialog-only .dl-btn; check row is .ko-check-row.
system-usb-*: System dialogs unified on .ko-dialog: .ko-btn buttons, .ko-check-row (4px top margin, 14px tick), .ko-meter storage bar.
system-error-*: System dialogs unified on .ko-dialog: .ko-btn buttons, .ko-kv list.
menus-settings-menu-help-*: Menu help now uses the one compact dialog style (17px semibold title, 400px wide, --r-lg corners, 16px action spacing) instead of the old default dialog (18px title, 420px, --r-xl).
reader-qr-code-*: QR dialog now uses the one compact dialog style (17px title, 400px, --r-lg).
reader-hyphenate-word-*: Hyphenate dialog now uses the one compact dialog style (17px title, 400px, --r-lg).
home-library-new-collection-*: New-collection dialog uses the one compact dialog style; its option is a .ko-check-row (same as every dialog).
search-stats-search-*: Search: scope pills are standard .ko-chip (32px, 1px accent outline when selected, row height kept), Open/Resume is a 40px .ko-btn--sm, format tags are .ko-pill--caps, scope counts use the chip count style (regular weight).
system-welcome-*: Welcome step titles snapped 28→26px (--fs-display, on the type scale): everything below moves up ~2px. Theme picker selection mark is the shared .ko-selmark; storage meter is .ko-meter.
home-library-view-sheet-*: View sheet: layout tiles are .ko-card option tiles (1px border + 1px accent ring instead of a 1.5/2px border; same footprint), check badge is .ko-selmark (24px), chip/segment icons 13→14px (--icon-xs); 1–2px shifts follow.
home-library-book-details-*: Book details: section headings/eyebrows are .ko-eyebrow (icons 13→14px), status is .ko-seg--block --icons, Arabic author line 20→18px (--fs-lg, on the scale), progress 'small' unit 16→15px.
dialogs-quick-settings-*: Quick settings: header from UI.sheetHead, tiles are .ko-card (same look), close/gear via UI.iconButton.
dialogs-frontlight-*: Frontlight: header from UI.sheetHead; sheet is .ko-sheet--phone.
library-extras-tools-vocabulary-*: Vocabulary: tags are .ko-pill--tint (11→10.5px), dialog parts are .ko-dialog-*, page header is .ko-header--page.
library-extras-tools-paste-conflict*: Paste conflict: tags are .ko-pill / .ko-pill--tint (11→10.5px), dialog buttons .ko-btn, check row .ko-check-row.
library-extras-tools-opds-*: OPDS: dialog/sheet buttons are .ko-btn (16px padding, semibold primary), check rows .ko-check-row.
home-library-home-dashboard-*: Home: eyebrows are .ko-eyebrow (icons 13→14px), quote 21→22px (--fs-xl), meta icons 13→14px, primary Resume semibold.
dialogs-keyboard-*: Underlying Home screen changes only (eyebrow icons 13→14px); Done key unchanged.
reader-end-of-book-*: Book end: rating stars are .ko-stars--lg (unrated stars --border-strong instead of --text-3, 28px icons kept at 44px hit), stat tiles typography from .ko-stat.
reader-typeset-*: Typeset: 'Aa' tab glyph 19→18px (--fs-lg), presets/rotation tiles are .ko-card option tiles with .ko-selmark (24px).
reader-skim*: Skim: 'Back to page' pill is a .ko-chip.
